name: Sonnet deep value
strategy: Round 2: rotate into unloved cyclical/value large-caps (energy, financials, autos, healthcare) that missed the AI-led melt-up, add small-cap value beta via IWM, and run a small levered short-BTC hedge against a continuing crypto bear, holding sizable cash for drawdown buys.

positions.thesis: Integrated energy major at mid-single-digit FCF yield, low P/E, strong buyback/dividend support; classic deep value in a sector that lagged AI-led H1.
Best-in-class bank at reasonable P/B with rising net interest income and capital return; financials remain cheap relative to the broad tape.
Single-digit P/E automaker with heavy buybacks and normalized truck/SUV margins; deep value optionality on any capex discipline or EV cost cuts.
Managed-care leader sold off to a multi-year-low P/E on medical-cost fears; healthcare defensiveness plus mean-reversion setup into H2.
Big pharma at low P/E with above-average dividend yield and improving pipeline optionality after post-COVID reset.
Small/mid-cap value basket catching up after a long large-cap AI-led divergence; cheaper aggregate multiples than SPY/QQQ.
Deep-value auto name trading below book with high dividend yield; a levered bet on consumer credit holding up and cost cuts sticking.

Crypto remains in a confirmed H1 bear trend (BTC -27%, ETH -36%, SOL -40%); modest levered short as a portfolio hedge/tactical continuation bet, sized so a 9-10% BTC rally only stops out this sleeve, not the book.

outlook: Expect mean-reversion into cheap cyclicals/value as H1's narrow AI-infra melt-up cools, while crypto stays pressured in its bear trend; keep meaningful cash for the next drawdown-driven entry.
